subject: Exec approval: Mediva hosted API pricing concession request
messages:
From: Alan Reyes <alan.reyes@medivahealth.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medivahealth.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pilot — request for deeper introductory pricing

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team was impressed with the latency and the telemetry. We're planning a 9-month pilot across three product teams and expect steady ramp in Q4.

One ask up front: our procurement lead is pushing for a stronger introductory rate to make the cross-team pilots viable. Given the volume profile (attached forecast) and the multi-product uptake, is Redwood able to consider a one-time strategic concession in the 25% range off list Hosted API usage pricing for the first 6 months?

If we can get that, we can commit to a 12-month expansion cadence and introduce Redwood into our partner vendor list. I can share numbers with finance if helpful.

Attachment: Mediva_Q3_forecast.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Alan Reyes
Head of Integrations, Mediva Health
alan.reyes@medivahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pilot — request for deeper introductory pricing

Ben / Mina — forwarding a direct ask from Mediva. They want ~25% off Hosted API list for first 6 months in exchange for an onboarding commitment and partner intro.

Quick context:
- Pilot: expected 3 teams, ramp to ~300M tokens/mo by month 6 per their forecast (see attachment).
- Value: strategic health customer, references, and potential marketplace listing.
- Risk: >20% off requires exec signoff per pricing policy.

I recommend we consider a limited-time 25% concession with these guardrails:
- 6-month introductory window only
- Minimum monthly commit ramp schedule (outlined in attached term sheet)
- Standard telemetry and usage review at month 3

Attached: Proposed_Terms_Mediva_25pct.docx (docx) — I drafted conditional language to protect unit economics.

Can we get exec clearance? Ben, I know you prefer to loop Marcus for commercial posture; Mina, can you weigh in on risk and precedent?

Thanks — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com, chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pilot — request for deeper introductory pricing

Chloe / Mina — I reviewed the forecast and the term draft. Two quick notes:

1) The forecast shows an aggressive token ramp. If we get even half of that, lifetime value justifies concession.
2) We need guardrails: a) auto-revert to standard list after 6 months, b) overage clause if usage exceeds forecast significantly, c) a binding onboarding commitment.

Mina — can we quantify worst-case unit cost at 25% off for their projected mix (generation vs embeddings)? If midpoint economics still look ok, I support escalation to Marcus and request his permission to sign a 25% concession for onboarding only.

If Marcus greenlights, I propose we accept 25% with a clause that the discount only applies to tokens up to forecasted monthly cap; additional tokens bill at standard list until we renegotiate.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 17:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pilot — request for deeper introductory pricing

Ben / Chloe — ran numbers with infra and product. Summary:

- 25% concession across pure Hosted API usage (mix in forecast: ~80% generation, 20% embeddings) pushes unit margin close to 12% in months 3–6 under base kernel selection; worst-case (higher gen length) drops margin below threshold.
- Suggested mitigations we should include in any approval:
  - Token cap tied to their submitted forecast; discount applies only up to cap each month.
  - Auto-reversion to standard list on month 7.
  - Quarterly telemetry review; if quality/abuse signals appear, Redwood may suspend concession.
  - Reciprocal commitments: Mediva to list Redwood in vendor portal and participate in 1 case study.

Marcus — given strategic value, I am comfortable recommending a one-time 25% concession under the above mitigations. Marcus, can you authorize? If you approve, I will prepare the final approval language for legal + finance signoff.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
From: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 5 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pilot — request for deeper introductory pricing

All — I reviewed the proposal and support a controlled 25% introductory concession with the mitigations Mina outlined. Conditions:

- Discount: 25% off Hosted API list pricing for months 1–6, applied only to tokens up to the monthly cap in their submitted forecast.
- Reversion: Automatic return to standard list on month 7 unless a new agreement is signed.
- Safeguards: Monthly telemetry reports shared with Revenue Ops; immediate suspension right if signal thresholds (latency/abuse/cost spikes) are met.
- Commercial reciprocity: Mediva commits to a marketplace listing and a quoted case study within 9 months.
- Legal/Finance: final T&Cs to be reviewed, but commercial clearance granted.

Chloe — you have exec clearance to offer this commercially conditional concession. Mina / Ben, please include the financial guardrails in the term sheet and route to Legal for a short form amendment.

Marcus Lin
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
From: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
To: Alan Reyes <alan.reyes@medivahealth.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@medivahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@medivahealth.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 5 Sep 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pilot — request for deeper introductory pricing

Alan / Sara — great news: Redwood can offer a one-time 25% introductory concession for months 1–6 with the following conditions (high level):

- Discount applies only to tokens up to the monthly cap in your submitted forecast (attachment).
- Auto-reversion to standard Hosted API list pricing on month 7.
- Monthly telemetry reports and a review at month 3.
- Redwood retains the right to pause concession if telemetry indicates misuse or material cost/quality issues.
- In exchange, Mediva agrees to: a) commit to a 12-month onboarding cadence and b) publish a case study and marketplace listing within 9 months of pilot start.

If this aligns, I will loop Legal and Finance for a short-form amendment and send a signed commercial approval memo.

Attachment: Proposed_Terms_Mediva_25pct.docx (docx)

Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
